info.title: Faclab API — invoices
info.description: The electronic documents of faclab-core's public API (`/api/v1/invoices`), served by faclab-invoicing behind the same domain and token. Same conventions: camelCase JSON, money as decimal strings, `{data, meta}` and `{errors, meta}`, stable order with `sort` and `updatedSince`, rate limits with `RateLimit-*` headers and 429 `RATE_LIMITED` with `Retry-After`.

tags.name: Invoices
tags.description: Invoices and credit notes of the sales.

get.description: The electronic documents of the company's sales in the branches this client may see. Sync them with `updatedSince` (ordered by `updatedAt`, then id); `from` and `to` filter by when they were created. `sort`: `createdAt`, `updatedAt` or `id`, with a leading `-` descending.

documentType.description: An invoice, or a credit note of a refund or a cancelled sale.

creditedInvoiceId.description: The invoice a credit note modifies; null in an invoice.

branchId.description: The sale's branch in faclab-core; null in documents from before it was kept.

number.description: Its number, 001-002-000000123, once it has one.

accessCode.description: The 49-digit SRI access code, once it has one.

status.description: PROCESSING while it is on its way to the SRI (it may wait for the issuer to be ready), AUTHORIZED or REJECTED. New values may be added.

total.description: Its total with VAT in USD, as a decimal string.
Records that match the query, in all pages.
